note: Seasonal theme definition. Both renderers (scripts/build.py and the Next components) read this file, take Chicago's local date, and emit data-season on the document root. Boundaries are the astronomical equinox and solstice dates, fixed to the day; they drift by at most a day year to year, which is well below the difference anyone would notice on a site. Palettes override the base tokens only. Art and structure never change with the season.
